title: Ether Escrow — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Ether Escrow solution should meet the objective: Build an escrow state machine on a local chain with funded, released, and refunded states. Use test funds and define a safe failure policy; do not deploy to mainnet. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
